_notes: THE FLIGHT LOOP, ALONE. wind_core_6f.png is 1536x1024 over 3x2 and divides
exactly into 512px cells, like every core sheet in this pack. No rects, no
canvas, no scale steps.
A REAL DEFECT, CONFIRMED RATHER THAN JUST QUOTED FROM THE README: the README
warns of 'near-transparent canvas residue (sampled corner alpha 1/255)'.
Measured here it is not a one-pixel corner accident -- 15.6% of the WHOLE
1536x1024 sheet sits at alpha 1-7 and another 6.6% sits at alpha 8-127, against
fire's and water's 0.8-3.2% in that same band. Composited on a light background
it reads as a faint soft rounded-square smudge behind each crescent (checked --
see the report); on the dark stage backdrop it is invisible, which is the one
reason it ships rather than being escalated. Left as delivered: nothing in this
recipe's tools re-keys or crops that residue away, because it is graded alpha
over the WHOLE canvas rather than a rectangle a crop could remove.
SHAPE: not a pointed, forward-leaning silhouette the way fire's spearhead or
water's ball are -- it is a closed crescent/vortex ring, near-symmetric, with
no strongly directional 'this end leads' read. Still travels fine as a moving
blob; it just does not sell direction of travel by silhouette alone the way
the other two cores do. Worth a look in motion (see report).
LOOP SEAM: the six cells are near-duplicate crescent swirls with only the
flourish detail differing frame to frame, which loops cleanly by construction
-- there is no strong pose change to create a visible seam.
